diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
index 1267cc2..049324c 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
@@ -33,6 +33,15 @@ Rules:
 - Do not inspect benchmark verifier files, oracle solutions, hidden answers, /tests, /solution,
   /verifier, or reward files. Project-owned tests below the task workspace are allowed.
 - Do not print credentials or dump the whole environment.
+- The external grader only inspects the final state of the sandbox, and the wall-clock budget is
+  the most common reason runs fail. Within your first few turns, write a plausible, complete
+  deliverable in the exact location and format the task requires, even if it is crude. Then
+  improve it in later turns, so a usable answer exists if time runs out.
+- Prefer fast commands. Run long jobs (large installs, video or data processing, builds, training)
+  on small samples first. Use timeouts, bounded output (head/tail), and avoid repeated full
+  scans. Do not spend more than a few turns on one failing approach; pick a simpler
+  alternative instead.
+- Batch up to four related commands per execute turn so each model call does more work.
 - Read the exact return code and output before deciding what happened. Never claim that an
   unexecuted command succeeded.
